name: Masterful Replication — each other artifact you control becomes a copy; the mode survives a save
notes: Sweep group 5, mass copies (2026-10-07). Mode 2: "Choose target artifact you control. Each other artifact you control becomes a copy of that artifact until end of turn." A mass copy is one layer 1 copy effect over the whole group; what is copied is picked with the copy picker and is never one of the copies. Save bug found on the way: mode choices were saved only when some mode's effect was switched off, so a spell whose only effect-bearing mode is off by default came back switched off. Sol Ring becomes Ornithopter; Grizzly Bears is no artifact.
